TextBlock.Text: BANDA SEA, 2034. The YF-23 went into production, the AIM-260 and the AIM-424 exist in quantity, the Rafale F5 carries LRASM and the J-36 and J-50 are operational squadrons rather than airframes on a taxiway. A bomber stream is going north-east against a relocatable launcher complex with the RQ-180 ahead of it, and the opposing force has put up everything it does not officially have. Darwin is beyond the escorts' reach. They recover to the Langgur strip on the Kai Islands or to USS Enterprise, south-east of the track.
The bomber stream releases on the launcher complex or it does not. Get the escorts home either way; range is still range.
Stream: Put the stream's release on the launcher complex Escort: Keep the escort fighters alive Sensor: Keep the RQ-180 alive

Two YF-23, one F-15EX, an F-16CM with JATM, a Rafale F5, the RQ-180, a B-52O, a B-1B and a B-52H in the stream. Opposing: J-36, J-50, a Tu-95MA with Meteorit, a Type 004 picket and a relocatable launcher complex.
80 minutes. The operation ends when the clock runs out, and the main objective fails with it.

YF-23 Black Widow II, F-15 EX Eagle II, RQ-180 White Bat Airframe, B-1B Lancer, B-52H Stratofortress, J-36 Tailless Fighter, Shenyang J-50 (沈阳航空工业 歼-50), 3M25 <<МЕТЕОРИТ>> (AS-X-19 Koala), PLA Land Unit Pack, Type 003 Fujian / Type 004 CVN Aircraft Carriers, Modern Chinese Airbase (Large), Gerald R. Ford-class CVN Aircraft Carrier (Updated Dependencies), the base game, this pack.
